efe579a87e3ecdbce3e4: A Module is a mechanical device with a defined function. It can provide physical abilities, utility, combat effects or other applications specified by its project.
9c6b232312ae66579a9d: Effects are not granted generically by the Cyborg Race: they depend on the Modules actually installed and their rules.

afe88276a22f78dd927b: A Module's passive effects work only while that Module is active. Details of construction, activation, energy and repairs are covered in the Modules and Technology chapter.

13c528a2793fec23554f: Normal healing through Medicine does not recover a Cyborg's HP.

82dcfa33c717e77cc975: Recovering HP and repairing a Module are two separate interventions.

2ccdf1f8b980ab9f13dd: Improving Strength does not automatically increase slots, and developing Mechanical Body does not automatically increase Strength.

05c0e5372d95c2eb7703: In Grand Line Chronicles, Role represents the character's main specialisation. Some Roles include several Styles, allowing a specific path within the same profession to be chosen.
3fd0f88b04f2c06eeaf7: This chapter describes how Roles and Styles work, which Skills are associated with each and how to access their Talents.
bbdfcb34fa80cb1c9992: The Fighter is a character who has made combat their specialisation. They can rely on their body, blades, ranged weapons or the devastating force of heavy blunt weapons.
9f069dd2445b7224a5de: Choosing Fighter does not mean automatically gaining all these abilities. The player must select a Style, which determines the Role Skill, Talent path and conditions for using specialist abilities.
9109abda69151ef8b8a1: When choosing Fighter as your Main Role, select one of the four available Styles.
cf81e568a57db9caa4e6: The Skill associated with the chosen Style starts at d8.
ae251bcc22024e89849d: For the Striker, the player chooses only one Skill between Athletics and Acrobatics. They do not receive both at d8.
e2203dcb0a58d1b029c5: An unarmed fighter specialising in punches, kicks, grapples and close-range combinations.
d3f4214023b7cb5790cd: A fighter specialising in blades, cutting techniques and parries.
fcade37873e220c5d48e: A fighter specialising in precision, positioning and ranged attacks.
eabf1f98d045a1eb6dc6: A fighter who exploits heavy blunt weapons to deal devastating blows and control the battle through impact.

0a3a72063890232d93cd: Their Role Skill can be Athletics or Acrobatics, chosen by the player.
eb5d625e2a7e229f6bc4: This decision determines which Skill starts at d8 and serves as the reference for the Style's Talent requirements.
8005e88c85081a626911: The Striker can develop abilities such as Flurry, devoted to consecutive attacks, and Lightning Step, linked to rapid movement. The path also includes Talents based on grapples, defence and counterattacks.
af9c8b2fadf51823f8e6: Fundamental restriction: Techniques and Talents requiring the Striker Style cannot be applied to attacks made with weapons.
e617ad30fb1ac40f7da5: A Technique created for the Striker must respect this identity.

f9865ee95f0fb03929c9: The Style includes abilities developing combat with one or more blades, parries and cutting techniques.
923df7e7b686f985b0d9: Their Talents can modify how the character uses blades, but every effect retains the requirements stated in its description.

b1e28ea525e0d61f62bb: Simply owning a sword also does not automatically grant Swordsman Talents: they must be acquired through progression.

f35bfc1c2856ff3639c6: A Sniper can naturally defend or perform physical actions like any other character. Their specialisation, however, applies to attacks meeting the relevant Talent requirements.
2525b76bdf2f59acf428: Fundamental restriction: Sniper benefits intended for ranged attacks do not automatically transfer to melee blows.

179f6c4e852d0c638725: The Style is built around particularly powerful blows, controlling balance and exploiting weapon impact.
7425a2b894c4a24978da: Among their Talents is Heavy Strike, allowing increased offensive pressure by paying a higher Stamina cost and accepting reduced defensive capabilities during the turn, according to the Grade and description of the Talent owned.
c53701d21e0fae0ae7c5: The path also includes abilities related to stability, demolition and shockwaves.
